title: Dasakam 40 — Pūtanāmokṣam
description: Nanda meets Vasudeva in Mathura; Putana comes to Gokula in disguise, takes the infant Krishna, and is defeated; the gopis rescue and protect the child.

source.commentary: intake/D040/photo-captions.txt; source mapping and export metadata preserved under content/sources/d040/

translation_note: No sourced English verse translation is included; translation_en is intentionally empty pending editorial review.

stanzas.sanskrit:
तदनु नन्दममन्दशुभास्पदं
नृपपुरीं करदानकृते गतम् ।
समवलोक्य जगाद भवत्पिता
विदितकंससहायजनोद्यमः ॥ ४०-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tadanu nandam amandaśubhāspadaṃ
nṛpapurīṃ karadānakṛte gatam |
samavalokya jagāda bhavatpitā
viditakaṃsasahāyajanodyamaḥ || 40-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: King Nandagopan went to the kingdom of Mathura to pay taxes where Kamsa is ruling,. Vasudeva met Nadagopan and talked affectionately and very friendly to him.

stanzas.sanskrit:
अयि सखे तव बालकजन्म मां
सुखयतेऽद्य निजात्मजजन्मवत् ।
इति भवत्पितृतां व्रजनायके
समधिरोप्य शशंस तमादरात् ॥ ४०-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ayi sakhe tava bālakajanma māṃ
sukhayate’dya nijātmajajanmavat |
iti bhavatpitṛtāṃ vrajanāyake
samadhiropya śaśaṃsa tamādarāt || 40-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Vasudeva congratulated Nandagopan and expressed his happiness over him on the birth of a son and conveyed that he is as happy as he would have got one.

stanzas.sanskrit:
इह च सन्त्यनिमित्तशतानि ते
कटकसीम्नि ततो लघु गम्यताम् ।
इति च तद्वचसा व्रजनायको
भवदपायभिया द्रुतमाययौ ॥ ४०-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
iha ca santyanimittaśatāni te
kaṭakasīmni tato laghu gamyatām |
iti ca tadvacasā vrajanāyako
bhavadapāyabhiyā drutamāyayau || 40-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Vasudeva warned Nandagopan of the bad omens which are felt at Gokulam at that time and hence instructed him to return home back as quickly as possible. Hearing it, Nandagopan was apprehended and took his way to Gokulam.

stanzas.sanskrit:
अवसरे खलु तत्र च काचन
व्रजपदे मधुराकृतिरङ्गना ।
तरलषट्पदलालितकुन्तला
कपटपोतक ते निकटं गता ॥ ४०-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
avasare khalu tatra ca kācana
vrajapade madhurākṛtiraṅganā |
taralaṣaṭpadalālitakuntalā
kapaṭapotaka te nikaṭaṃ gatā || 40-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: In the meanwhile, Putana, the demoness, under Kamsa's order visited Nandagopan's house in the disguise of a beautiful woman, with hair adorned with beautiful and attractive flowers.

stanzas.sanskrit:
सपदि सा हृतबालकचेतना
निशिचरान्वयजा किल पूतना ।
व्रजवधूष्विह केयमिति क्षणं
विमृशतीषु भवन्तमुपाददे ॥ ४०-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sapadi sā hṛtabālakacetanā
niśicarānvayajā kila pūtanā |
vrajavadhūṣviha keyamiti kṣaṇaṃ
vimṛśatīṣu bhavantamupādade || 40-5 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Putana, who killed several infants, lifted Krishna in her hand. The other Gopikas wondered amongst themselves as to who this beautiful lady was.

stanzas.sanskrit:
ललितभावविलासहृतात्मभि-
-र्युवतिभिः प्रतिरोद्धुमपारिता ।
स्तनमसौ भवनान्तनिषेदुषी
प्रददुषी भवते कपटात्मने ॥ ४०-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
lalitabhāvavilāsahṛtātmabhi-
-ryuvatibhiḥ pratiroddhumapāritā |
stanamasau bhavanāntaniṣeduṣī
pradaduṣī bhavate kapaṭātmane || 40-6 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Awestruck by her charming looks, Gopikas did not obstruct her when she took the child in her hand. She chose a place in the house and started to feed the child with her breast milk.

stanzas.sanskrit:
समधिरुह्य तदङ्कमशङ्कित-
-स्त्वमथ बालकलोपनरोषितः ।
महदिवाम्रफलं कुचमण्डलं
प्रतिचुचूषिथ दुर्विषदूषितम् ॥ ४०-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
samadhiruhya tadaṅkamaśaṅkita-
-stvamatha bālakalopanaroṣitaḥ |
mahadivāmraphalaṃ kucamaṇḍalaṃ
praticucūṣitha durviṣadūṣitam || 40-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Angered at Putana's killing of innocent children, Krishna fearlessly climbed on to her body and sucked the poison smeared breasts as if it was a huge mango fruit.

stanzas.sanskrit:
असुभिरेव समं धयति त्वयि
स्तनमसौ स्तनितोपमनिस्वना ।
निरपतद्भयदायि निजं वपुः
प्रतिगता प्रविसार्य भुजावुभौ ॥ ४०-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
asubhireva samaṃ dhayati tvayi
stanamasau stanitopamanisvanā |
nirapatadbhayadāyi nijaṃ vapuḥ
pratigatā pravisārya bhujāvubhau || 40-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna sucked the life of Putana, acting as if he was sucking the milk. She fell on the ground making thunderous sound with both hands stretched, reverting to her huge demoness form.

stanzas.sanskrit:
भयदघोषणभीषणविग्रह-
-श्रवणदर्शनमोहितवल्लवे ।
व्रजपदे तदुरःस्थलखेलनं
ननु भवन्तमगृह्णत गोपिकाः ॥ ४०-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhayadaghoṣaṇabhīṣaṇavigraha-
-śravaṇadarśanamohitavallave |
vrajapade taduraḥsthalakhelanaṃ
nanu bhavantamagṛhṇata gopikāḥ || 40-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Hearing the huge sound, entire Gokulam was in a state of shock. Seeing Krishna playing innocently on the dead body of Putana, Gopikas came and picked him up hurriedly.

stanzas.sanskrit:
भुवनमङ्गलनामभिरेव ते
युवतिभिर्बहुधा कृतरक्षणः ।
त्वमयि वातनिकेतननाथ मा-
-मगदयन् कुरु तावकसेवकम् ॥ ४०-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhuvanamaṅgalanāmabhireva te
yuvatibhirbahudhā kṛtarakṣaṇaḥ |
tvamayi vātaniketananātha mā-
-magadayan kuru tāvakasevakam || 40-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Gopikas prayed to Bhagwan, chanting his various names which brings auspiciousness to the world, seeking him to protect the child without knowing that Bhagwan only is in the form of child Krishna in their hands.
